description: An opaque cream long-sleeved undertunic with narrow woven neck and cuff borders lies beneath a burgundy full-length sleeveless outer garment with broad gold woven edging. A burgundy shoulder drape fastened by two round chest clasps hangs along the arms and sides. A broad dark patterned belt with an oval clasp and a decorated hanging tab secures the waist. Dark trousers and tall brown leather boots are visible.
